digest.component_or_area: Plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation specification
propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes in scope
The exact scope clause and co-located four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier must appear in plan_review_T10.md with the qualifier immediately following the scope clause
T10 rubric must remain independent and not reference or assign scope to T15 or any other overlay

The packaged eval spec must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls (scoped teardown, fully specified durable, private-network scoped-IAM transient, secret-manager transient, sandboxed-teardown transient) and five finding controls (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient service)

Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier, rubric independence, and pass/finding agentic behavior via live criterion evaluation with recall and no-fire gates
